problem: SMEs handle HR administration, payroll and expense reimbursement manually.

founders.name: Ghuniyu Fattah Rozaq
founders.background_notes: YC page: 9 plus years in security and software engineering

competitors.name: Mekari Talenta
competitors.what: HR and payroll software for Indonesian businesses
competitors.traction_then: Mekari raised 18M Series D (Jakarta Post, Jan 2022)

competitors.name: Gadjian
competitors.funding_then: Golden Gate Ventures round in 2016, amount undisclosed

competitors.name: GajiGesa
competitors.what: Indonesian earned wage and HR startup

technical_complexity.rationale: HRIS with attendance and payroll is conventional SaaS; Indonesian tax (PPh 21) and BPJS rules add local complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Payroll data creates some lock-in but several funded local incumbents exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were established and funded in January 2022; no later takeover event found.

market_need_then: Jakarta Post (Jan 2022) described HR tech in Indonesia as nascent but attracting funding, indicating demand among SMEs.

identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly, simple, mainly Indonesian (People First HR Partner)

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found; site uses Y Combinator affiliation as credibility.

outcome_analysis: StafBook is an active Indonesian HRIS for SMEs that claims 100 plus customer companies on its site. No verified funding, exit or shutdown was found, and aggregators only show a small seed of about 500 thousand dollars. It faces funded local incumbents such as Mekari Talenta, so the story is of a small steady business with unknown growth.
notes: Caplight lists a 500K seed dated 2022-03-29 (aggregator only), unverified, not recorded as a round. Aggregators mention a Startup Studio Indonesia program, not linked to the company by a primary source. Competitor source is a Jakarta Post article about Gajiku, dated 2022-01. Completeness pass: a 500K seed (Caplight, 2022-03-29) is recorded from a single database; Seedtable dates a seed 2022-04 with no amount and names Y Combinator and Goodwater Capital.
